description: This file defines internal interfaces and enums related to the runtime management of Orleans streaming providers, including methods for retrieving the executing entity identity, stream directories, and pub/sub mechanisms, as well as initializing pulling agents for persistent streams.

classes.name: IStreamProviderRuntime
classes.description: Interface for managing streaming providers, providing methods to get identity, stream directory, and pub/sub system.

classes.name: ISiloSideStreamProviderRuntime
classes.description: Extends IStreamProviderRuntime with functionality to initialize pulling agents for persistent stream providers.

classes.name: StreamPubSubType
classes.description: Enumeration of stream pub/sub system types, such as explicit, implicit, or both.

classes.name: IStreamPubSub
classes.description: Interface representing the pub/sub system, with methods for registering/unregistering producers and consumers, counting, and managing subscriptions.

methods.name: ExecutingEntityIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves the identity of the current executing grain or client.

methods.name: GetStreamDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory containing stream information.

methods.name: PubSub
methods.description: Returns an instance implementing the IStreamPubSub interface based on pub/sub type.

methods.name: InitializePullingAgents
methods.description: Starts pulling agents for a specified persistent stream provider.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a specific stream.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from a stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer subscription to a stream.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Removes a consumer subscription from a stream.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers for a given stream.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for a given stream.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a stream, optionally filtered by consumer.

methods.name: CreateSubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a subscription identifier based on stream and consumer info.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Marks a subscription as faulty, possibly for recovery.

Task<List<StreamSubscription>> GetAllSubscriptions(QualifiedStreamId streamId, GrainId streamConsumer = default)
